user.title: Pair Jukelet publisher
user.description: Enter the exact current app publisher UUID. Confirm new pairing, or explicitly reattach intact existing history after interrupted setup/removal. Reattachment never resets history or changes the publisher.

data.confirm_pairing: I confirm this publisher owns assignments and reviewed the installation state
data.reattach_existing: Reattach existing verified publisher history without resetting it

error.recovery_required: Existing or uncertain storage found. Restore the full HA backup; do not delete bridge storage.

abort.unsupported_version: This release supports HA Core 2026.10.2 only. Keep the backup and use a tested release.

init.title: Recover or replace publisher
init.description: Stop the app publisher. Preserve a full HA backup. Paste a reviewed complete v1 snapshot from the authoritative app, using a revision above every retained publisher and the exact active base. This does not clear the app recovery guard.

confirm.title: Confirm recovery
confirm.description: Current revision: {current}. Recovery revision floor (history and validated snapshot): {floor}. Candidate publisher: {publisher}; revision: {revision}; checksum: {checksum}; mappings: {count}. A changed UUID retires the former publisher permanently. Empty mappings remove all bridge mappings. Dispatch remains disabled.

data.confirm_recovery: I reviewed the backup, publisher, content, revision and empty-mapping consequences

abort.recovery_rejected: State changed, history is unavailable, or recovery is unsafe. Read status and restart/review before retrying.
